page.overview:
Who is Gartan?

While is still active, reveals that it makes traveling to from dangerous. However, he refuses to let it stop him from meeting ladies. He is also very worried about the presence of thieves in .

If saves from monsters, he may say how close of a save it was to himself. He considers the only thing scarier than monsters to be women. His strategy for surviving attacks is to run away. He gives for saving him.

In addition to selling his wares, will also purchase from . He is appreciative of the products he is able to buy, and he asks if has more for him.
